name: WANTED: Andre Firebeard
summary: In Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, a wanted notice names Andre Firebeard and accuses him of crimes against both places. Deliver his head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle at Steamwheedle Port, and it counts as a binding contract.

sections.title: The Decree
sections.body: A notice condemns Andre Firebeard as a vile pirate accused of crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan. The governing counsel allows anyone who reads it to use lethal force to capture Andre and those who aid him. He can be found at the pirate enclave south along the coast from Steamwheedle Port, standing by a campfire inside its walls.

sections.title: The Head as Proxy
sections.body: A further decree says Andre's head may speak for him if he is dead or otherwise unable to attend his hearing. Delivered to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle at Steamwheedle Port, it counts as a binding contract.

sections.title: Terms of Payment
sections.body: Bilgewhizzle is pleased that Andre will make his trial after all. Payment comes once you sign. He waves off the small print as harmless, saying it is too small for any magnifying glass to read.

faq.answer: Andre Firebeard is a pirate accused of crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where can the wanted notice be found?
faq.answer: The wanted notice is posted in Gadgetzan and at Steamwheedle Port.
Andre Firebeard is at a campfire inside the walls of the pirate enclave south along the coast from Steamwheedle Port.

faq.q: Who receives the head once Andre is dealt with?
aliases: who do i turn in firebeard to
where to turn in firebeard head
faq.answer: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle receives the head at Steamwheedle Port.
A decree lets his head act in Andre's place if he is dead or otherwise unable to attend his hearing.
